name: Miwana's Longhouse
summary: Miwana's Longhouse serves as the primary inn and community lodge within Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom. Nestled among the tauren lodges, it provides shelter, warmth, and quiet hospitality to weary travelers visiting the Horde capital. Inside and around its grounds, visitors also find craftspeople and spiritual mentors tending to the needs of the community.

sections.title: A Hearth in the Valley
sections.body: Located in the tranquil Valley of Wisdom, Miwana's Longhouse reflects the pastoral traditions of the tauren rather than the harsh steel of standard orcish architecture. Maintained by the innkeeper Miwana, the longhouse offers a peaceful respite away from the clatter of the Valley of Honor and the Drag. Travelers gathered around its hearth find not just a place to bind their spirits and rest, but also skilled instructors like the tailoring trainer Hiwahi Three-Feathers, while shaman instructors and leatherworkers gather around the communal fire pits outside.

faq.answer: The lodge is owned and operated by Innkeeper Miwana, a tauren who provides lodging, drinks, and hearthstone bindings to travelers and emissaries visiting the Valley of Wisdom.

faq.q: Where exactly is Miwana's Longhouse located?
faq.answer: It is situated in the Valley of Wisdom, the western plateau of Orgrimmar where the tauren enclave, druids, and shaman mentors gather.

faq.q: What trainers and services are available here?
faq.answer: Inside the longhouse, you can bind your hearthstone with Innkeeper Miwana and learn clothcraft from the tailoring trainer Hiwahi Three-Feathers. Just outside the lodge around the open bonfires, you can find shaman trainers and a skinning trainer.

faq.q: Why is there a tauren-style inn in an orcish city?
faq.answer: Orgrimmar is organized into distinct districts honoring the different peoples of the Horde. The Valley of Wisdom serves as the heart of tauren and spiritual presence in the city, constructed with their traditional hides, poles, and timber to make them feel at home in Durotar.

angles.text: For tauren visiting the harsh red canyons of Durotar, Miwana's Longhouse offers a welcome taste of the plains, built in the traditional lodge style of Mulgore.
Tailors can seek out Hiwahi Three-Feathers inside the lodge to hone their weaving and stitching craft.
